tldr: 台股週四收漲0.31%至45,975點，輝達財報點火半導體，惟指數開高收斂、外資加碼期指空單。
台積電AI營收上看兆元、訂單能見度達2028年，AI題材由GPU擴散至液冷、PCB與電源族群。
金管會公布明年八項新制，以IFRS 17與TW-ICS為核心，並以過渡措施減輕壽險型金控資本壓力。
主計總處大幅上修2026年GDP成長預估至約11.05%、創近40年新高，AI帶動出口估大增逾40%。
海外方面，輝達財報遠優預期、市值大增約4,400億美元，帶動美股創8月初以來最強單日，市場靜待聯準會主席沃許傑克遜霍爾首秀。

items.title_zh: 台股收漲142點站上45,975 輝達財報點火、法人買超643億
items.title_en: TAIEX ends up 0.31% at 45,975 as Nvidia earnings lift chip names
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週四（8/27）在輝達財報優於預期激勵下開高，終場上漲142.6點、漲幅0.31%，收45,975.22點，惟自盤中高點拉回逾400點，呈「開高收斂」。成交量約9,247億元，三大法人買超約643億元，但外資同步加碼期指空單，顯示高檔追價轉趨保守，短線指數在高基期震盪整理。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark closed Thursday (Aug 27) up 142.6 points, or 0.31%, at 45,975.22 after opening at the day's high and paring an early Nvidia-driven surge into the close. Turnover reached about NT$924.7 billion and the three major institutional investors were net buyers of roughly NT$64.3 billion, yet foreign players added to index-futures shorts, signalling caution even as cash equities firmed.

items.title_zh: 台積電財報亮眼外資卻續倒貨 華爾街「不買單」原因曝光
items.title_en: Foreign funds keep trimming TSMC even after a strong report
items.summary_zh: 台積電繳出亮眼財報，外資卻持續調節持股，華爾街分析多指向評價偏高與財報後獲利了結，而非基本面轉弱。強勁AI營運展望與外資保守布局形成拉鋸；因台積電市值與成交比重極高，其籌碼動向成為左右大盤方向的關鍵變數，短線牽動指數多空氣勢與量能表現。
items.summary_en: Despite TSMC's upbeat results, foreign institutions have continued to offload the shares, with Wall Street commentary flagging valuation and post-earnings profit-taking rather than any deterioration in fundamentals. The divergence between robust AI-driven guidance and cautious foreign positioning has become a key swing factor for the weighted index, given TSMC's outsized influence on Taiwan's market capitalisation and daily turnover.

items.title_zh: 台積電AI營收衝兆元大關 訂單能見度直達2028年
items.title_en: TSMC's AI revenue heads toward NT$1 trillion with visibility into 2028
items.summary_zh: 台積電估2026年AI相關營收上看400億美元、站穩兆元大關約1.24兆元，訂單能見度已延伸至2028年。董事長魏哲家指出，AI瓶頸不僅在晶圓代工，更橫跨電力、晶片產能、設備機台到上游材料供應鏈，凸顯AI建置需求對整體產業鏈的全面拉動與供給壓力，先進製程與封裝產能持續吃緊。
items.summary_en: TSMC expects AI-related revenue to top US$40 billion in 2026, breaking the NT$1 trillion mark at roughly NT$1.24 trillion, with order visibility now stretching to 2028. Chairman C.C. Wei said AI bottlenecks span power, chip capacity, equipment and upstream materials, not just the foundry itself, underscoring how broadly the build-out is straining the whole supply chain.

items.title_zh: AI題材由GPU擴散至液冷、PCB、電源 轉單傳言被指「小打小鬧」
items.title_en: AI theme broadens from GPUs to cooling, PCB and power as transfer-order talk fades
items.summary_zh: 市場焦點由GPU、AI伺服器擴散至整櫃式伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB／CCL與電源供應，帶動台廠硬體供應鏈全面受惠。業界分析認為，所謂台積電遭轉單的傳言僅屬小打小鬧，因AI時代先進製程定價權仍握在台積電手中，競爭對手難以大規模承接尖端產能需求，供應鏈題材輪動延續。
items.summary_en: Market attention is widening from GPUs and AI servers to rack-scale systems, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL and power supplies, spreading momentum across Taiwan's hardware chain. Industry commentary dismissed rumours of orders shifting away from TSMC as minor noise, arguing the foundry's pricing power in the AI era leaves rivals unable to absorb leading-edge demand at scale.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布明年8項新制 壽險業迎IFRS 17與ICS大轉型
items.title_en: FSC unveils eight new 2026 rules as life insurers brace for a major overhaul
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布2026年八項新制，核心為壽險業同步接軌IFRS 17與台版新一代清償能力制度（TW-ICS），業界稱為「元年」。IFRS 17以公允價值衡量保險負債，可望促使業者強化資產負債管理、提高保障型商品銷售；此外明年元旦起全體上市櫃公司須提前上傳股東會議事手冊及年報，收緊資訊揭露時程，全面提升治理透明度。
items.summary_en: The FSC outlined eight regulatory changes taking effect in 2026, headlined by the simultaneous adoption of IFRS 17 and the Taiwan version of the new solvency regime (TW-ICS), which the industry calls "year one." IFRS 17 measures insurance liabilities at fair value, and from January all listed companies must also upload shareholder-meeting handbooks and annual reports earlier, tightening disclosure timelines.

items.title_zh: 接軌TIS過渡措施出爐 8家壽險型金控資本大減壓
items.title_en: Transition measures ease capital strain on eight financial-holding groups
items.summary_zh: 為協助平順接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS），金管會銀行局預告「金融控股公司合併資本適足性管理辦法」修正草案，可望讓8家壽險型金控資本壓力大減，並使11家保險型金控適用延後一個月申報資本適足率。過渡措施降低接軌初期衝擊，替2026年制度正式上路預留緩衝，減輕金控增資壓力。
items.summary_en: To smooth the shift to the new solvency standard (TIS), the FSC's banking bureau previewed amendments to consolidated capital-adequacy rules for financial-holding companies. The changes are expected to relieve capital pressure on eight life-insurance-led financial holdings and let 11 insurance-type holdings defer their capital-adequacy filings by one month, cushioning the transition ahead of the 2026 rollout.

items.title_zh: 主動式ETF續強攻、高股息ETF轉守 2026資產配置分化
items.title_en: Active ETFs stay aggressive while high-dividend funds turn defensive
items.summary_zh: 2026年台股主動式ETF與高股息ETF呈現明顯分化：主動式ETF結合基金經理人選股彈性與ETF交易便利，追求超越大盤的Alpha；高股息ETF則側重防禦。理財顧問指出，資金在追求超額報酬與穩定配息間重新配置，主動式ETF成為財富管理端布局焦點，牽動高資產客戶核心持股策略的調整方向。
items.summary_en: In 2026 Taiwan's active ETFs and high-dividend ETFs are showing sharply different profiles—active funds chase alpha with manager-selected stocks while high-yield products emphasise defence. Advisers note active ETFs combine mutual-fund stock-picking flexibility with exchange-traded convenience, drawing wealth-management flows that seek returns above the index rather than pure yield.

items.title_zh: 存股族最愛10檔ETF出爐 00919配息壓力受關注
items.title_en: Dividend-ETF investors weigh payout cuts as 00919 faces distribution pressure
items.summary_zh: 2026年存股族最愛的10檔ETF排行揭曉，0050、00919、00878等居前，反映定期定額族群偏好轉變。分析指出，00919因成分股金融比重偏高，面臨配息壓力、恐須調降配息，提醒投資人高股息招牌未必等於穩定現金流，財富管理配置須留意標的殖利率與資本利得之間的平衡。
items.summary_en: A ranking of 2026's most-held income ETFs—0050, 00919, 00878 and peers—highlights shifting preferences among Taiwan's dividend investors. Analysts flag that 00919 faces distribution pressure and may trim payouts, partly because financial stocks make up a large share of its holdings, a reminder that high-yield labels do not guarantee stable income for wealth portfolios.

items.title_zh: 2026遺產稅、贈與稅級距調整 高資產傳承稅負減輕
items.title_en: Estate- and gift-tax brackets adjusted for 2026, easing large-estate transfers
items.summary_zh: 2026年遺產稅與贈與稅規定，免稅額與扣除額維持不變，主要變動在課稅級距調整，使高額資產傳承與贈與的稅負壓力略為減輕。顧問指出，此調整對富裕家庭的傳承規劃略有助益，但核心免稅門檻未變，資產移轉的時點與架構安排，仍是決定整體節稅與傳承效率的關鍵考量。
items.summary_en: For 2026 Taiwan's estate- and gift-tax rules keep exemptions and deductions unchanged but adjust the taxable brackets, lightening the burden on high-value inheritances and lifetime gifts. Advisers say the tweak modestly eases succession planning for wealthier families, yet because the core exemption thresholds are the same, the timing and structuring of transfers still drive overall tax efficiency.

items.title_zh: 國稅局提醒：房地合一重購退稅享5年列管限制
items.title_en: Tax office reminds sellers of the five-year lock-up on home-repurchase relief
items.summary_zh: 依房地合一稅2.0，個人經核准適用重購退稅優惠者，須留意「5年列管限制」，期間內若不符規定恐遭追繳、前功盡棄。申報須於房地完成所有權移轉登記日隔天起30日內辦理，且應向戶籍所在地國稅局申報，而非房屋所在地。國稅局提醒納稅人留意申報時點與地點，避免補稅並加計利息。
items.summary_en: Under the House and Land Transactions Income Tax (2.0), taxpayers approved for repurchase tax relief must observe a five-year monitoring period or risk forfeiting the benefit. Filing is due within 30 days of the transfer registration and must be made at the taxpayer's registered-household tax office, not where the property sits—points the bureau flags to avoid inadvertent clawbacks and interest charges.
items.source_name: 財政部臺北國稅局 房地合一專區

items.title_zh: 主計總處大幅上修2026經濟成長率 AI帶動出口創近40年最快
items.title_en: DGBAS sharply raises Taiwan's 2026 growth forecast on an AI-led export boom
items.summary_zh: 主計總處將2026年GDP成長預估大幅上修至約11.05%，創1987年以來近40年最快，較5月預測明顯調升，動能絕大部分來自AI相關需求。第二季以美元計價商品出口年增逾40%，受惠AI加速器、高效能運算與雲端基礎設施投資擴增，帶動台灣供應鏈出口動能延續，成為推升全年成長預估的主要力量。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's statistics agency lifted its 2026 GDP growth forecast to about 11.05%, its fastest in nearly four decades and well above the May projection, driven overwhelmingly by AI-related demand. Second-quarter dollar-denominated exports jumped more than 40% year on year, powered by AI accelerators, high-performance computing and cloud-infrastructure spending rippling through the supply chain.

items.title_zh: 2026出口估大增逾40% 2027有望突破兆美元
items.title_en: Exports forecast to surge over 40% in 2026, on track to top US$1 trillion by 2027
items.summary_zh: 同一預測指出，主計總處估2026年出口金額年增約41%，創1976年以來最快，2027年出口更有望突破1兆美元。主計總處認為，AI應用正由雲端訓練擴散至推論、代理與終端裝置，全球雲端服務商持續擴充基礎設施，AI加速器、客製化晶片與記憶體需求同步升溫，可望延續台灣供應鏈中期出口成長動能。
items.summary_en: The same forecast round sees 2026 exports rising about 41% at a pace not seen since 1976, with 2027 exports projected to break US$1 trillion. Officials expect AI to keep broadening from cloud training into inference, agentic applications and edge devices, sustaining demand for accelerators, custom silicon and memory that anchors Taiwan's export momentum through the medium term.

items.title_zh: 台媒報導：輝達終止連跌、美股四大指數收紅
items.title_en: Taiwan media: Wall Street's main indices close higher as Nvidia snaps its slide
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體報導最新美股盤後，四大指數在輝達（Nvidia）繳出優於預期財報、終止連續數日下跌後同步收紅，美債買氣亦回籠。評論指出，此反彈對台積電ADR與台灣AI硬體供應鏈形成正向指引，市場預期有助台股電子權值股於本地盤面延續買氣，帶動科技股情緒回穩、風險偏好升溫。
items.summary_en: Local coverage of the latest US session reported the major indices finishing in the green after Nvidia rebounded from a multi-session slump on the back of its blowout earnings, with Treasury demand returning. Commentators framed the bounce as a positive read-through for TSMC's ADR and Taiwan's AI hardware chain, supporting sentiment for heavyweight tech names heading into the local session.

items.title_zh: 台媒觀察：資金轉向財報贏家 晶片股區間震盪
items.title_en: Taiwan media: money rotates to earnings winners as chip stocks stay choppy
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體亦點出美股盤面下的資金輪動：大型晶片股因市場憂心AI巨額支出與中國競爭升溫而間歇承壓，惟標普500等權重指數改寫新高，資金轉進財報優於預期的族群，如房地產、原物料與公用事業。此顯示市場呈現「廣度擴散」，而非僅靠少數權值股領軍的格局，題材輪動更趨均衡。
items.summary_en: Reporting also highlighted a rotation beneath the surface: while large chip names came under intermittent pressure amid worries over heavy AI spending and rising Chinese competition, the equal-weighted S&P 500 pushed to a record and funds moved toward sectors posting strong beats—such as real estate, materials and utilities—signs of broadening rather than narrow, mega-cap-only leadership.

items.title_zh: 輝達財報遠優預期、市值單日大增逾4,000億美元
items.title_en: Nvidia adds more than $400 billion in value after blowout earnings boost AI confidence
items.summary_zh: 輝達股價單日大漲約8.7%，市值增加約4,400億美元，財報優於預期、經營層釋出強勁展望，重振市場對AI交易信心。輝達估2028會計年度營收成長上看約70%，遠高於分析師約44%預估，鞏固其作為AI相關資本支出風向球的地位。
items.summary_en: Nvidia shares jumped about 8.7% to add roughly $440 billion in market value after quarterly results beat expectations and management guided to strong growth, restoring confidence in the AI trade. The company forecast fiscal-2028 revenue growth near 70%, far above the roughly 44% analysts had modelled, cementing its role as the bellwether for AI-related capital spending.

items.title_zh: 輝達財報重點：黃仁勳看2028財年營收成長70%
items.title_en: Nvidia earnings takeaways: Huang forecasts 70% fiscal-2028 revenue growth
items.summary_zh: 輝達季度營收優於預期，資料中心業務為主要動能，執行長黃仁勳向投資人喊出2028會計年度營收將成長約70%，遠高於華爾街約44%的預估。經營層強調，隨雲端服務商持續擴充基礎設施，AI加速器與新世代系統需求可望延續，被市場解讀為AI景氣續強的訊號。
items.summary_en: Nvidia posted quarterly revenue above estimates with data-centre sales driving the beat, and CEO Jensen Huang told investors to expect revenue growth of about 70% in fiscal 2028—well ahead of Wall Street's ~44% estimate. Management cited sustained demand for AI accelerators and next-generation systems as cloud providers keep expanding their infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 美股創8月初以來最強單日 軟體與資安股飆漲
items.title_en: US stocks post best day since early August as software and cyber names surge
items.summary_zh: 標普500與那斯達克收高，寫下8月4日以來最強單日，那斯達克約漲1.6%、標普約漲0.7%。除輝達外，Salesforce因營收優於預期大漲逾22%；資安股Okta勁揚逾28%、CrowdStrike漲20.5%，因上修財測、受惠代理式AI需求爆發，帶動科技與軟體類股全面走高。
items.summary_en: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed higher in their strongest session since Aug. 4, with the Nasdaq up about 1.6% and the S&P about 0.7%. Beyond Nvidia, Salesforce jumped more than 22% on a revenue beat, while cybersecurity names Okta (+28%) and CrowdStrike (+20.5%) rallied after raising outlooks on booming agentic-AI demand.

items.title_zh: 市場靜待沃許傑克遜霍爾首秀
items.title_en: Investors count down to Warsh's Jackson Hole debut
items.summary_zh: 下一交易時段前，美股期指變動不大，市場靜待聯準會主席沃許（Kevin Warsh）於傑克遜霍爾（Jackson Hole）發表首場演說，以尋找貨幣政策路徑線索。在通膨數據偏熱、AI帶動股市續揚之際，交易人於演說前保守布局，視其為牽動利率與風險偏好的近期總經關鍵。
items.summary_en: Ahead of the next session US stock futures were little changed as markets awaited Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole address, watched for signals on the policy path. With inflation data running warm and the AI-driven rally extending, traders positioned cautiously into the speech, treating it as the near-term macro catalyst for rates and risk appetite.
